id.description:
Id of credential. For JdbcCredentials, it will be set based on {@link JdbcStoreConfig.name}. For CloudCredentials,
it will be set based on {@link CloudResource.resourceName}

serverEndpoint.description:
Server address of credential. It will be set based on {@link JdbcCredentials.serverEndpoint} or {@link
CloudCredentials.endpoint}

displayName.description:
Display name of credential. It will be set based on displayName property on {@link JdbcStoreConfig.description} or
{@link CloudResource.description}.

secretKey.description:
Cloud service native secret Key. This field is available for both  {@link JdbcCredentials} type and {@link
CloudCrednetials} type.

datastore.description: The data store type, including both JdbcStore types and FileSystem types.

filePathPrefix.description:
The file path prefix to the directory storing the shared files.
For Azure Data Lake, file path starts with the container name, i.e., `<container-name>/path/to/dir`
For AWS S3, file path starts with the bucket name, i.e., `<bucket-name>/path/to/dir

cloudIdentity.description:
Cloud service native identity for managing access to Cloud Resources. It is typically associated with compute
instance.

username.description:
User name of credential. It will be set based on {@link JdbcCredentials.username}. This field is only set for
{@link JdbcCredentials} type.

password.description: A hashed password of credential. This field is only set for {@link JdbcCredentials} type.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

title: Credential for the shared file storage service.
name: DataConnectorSharedFileStorageCredential
